steps.description: This is `src/index.js`. The page says your `src/index.js` should export a `transpile` function.
`transpile` takes the source. The comments mark the body as your lexer, parser, and code generator pipeline, and note that it returns a string of JavaScript or another target.
`module.exports = { transpile }` exports the function so `bin/mylang.js` can require it.
